summary: In Ansible 9.13.0 the planned removal of netapp.storagegrid was cancelled; the collection stays in Ansible 11 because another NetApp team took over maintenance.
questions: Is netapp.storagegrid being removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: netapp.storagegrid removal cancelled
answer_card.answer_md: The removal of **netapp.storagegrid** was cancelled (announced in Ansible 9.13.0). It will **not** be removed from Ansible 11; maintenance moved to another team at NetApp.
